patch.ZIP_and_gzip: Bounded two-level inspection for small memory-backed Git blobs and Actions ZIP entries
patch.findings: Store rule names + original outer blob ID or artifact ID/entry name; never print matched values
patch.failures: Ambiguous, corrupt, encrypted, unsafe-path, symlink, over-budget, too-deep or unsupported nested content remains INCOMPLETE
patch.unknown_formats: SQLite, zstd and binary NUL remain unqualified
patch.streamed_large_git_blobs: Prior bounded stream contract unchanged; large nested content remains INCOMPLETE
patch.sibling_findings: Do not erase detected patterns in inspected siblings if a different child is opaque

historical_observations.note: Counts are from earlier checkpoint 0122 audit; they are not predicted after this change.
